name: Butchering
//: Carcasses and what comes off them: blood, offal, sinew, prime meat, ivory, bones. Pegged to the base game: red meat 32, fat 16, a bone 24, a carcass 32, milk 10 a litre. A carcass is worth roughly what it yields when butchered (meat + hide + bones + sinew + offal), by the mod's own size tiers. Blood dough, bread and pie are 1.25x the base game's. Only used when nothing else values the item; the '//' lines say why each number was chosen.

defaultValues.//dead*: any carcass not listed below: a medium animal, two red meat's worth
defaultValues.//deadhare-*: a hare: bush meat (16) plus a small hide (16), halved for its size
defaultValues.//deadfox-*: a fox: bush meat plus a small hide
defaultValues.//deadraccoon-*: a raccoon: bush meat plus a small hide
defaultValues.//deadwolf-*: a wolf: red meat plus a medium hide
defaultValues.//deadhyena-*: a hyena: red meat plus a medium hide
defaultValues.//deadpig-*: a pig: two red meat (64) plus a medium hide (32)
defaultValues.//deadsheep-*: a sheep: two red meat plus a medium hide
defaultValues.//deadgoat-*: a goat: two red meat plus a medium hide
defaultValues.//deaddeer-*: a deer: two red meat plus a medium hide
defaultValues.//deadmoose-*: a moose: three or four red meat plus a huge hide (80)
defaultValues.//deadelephantidae-*: an elephant: a bear's worth plus ivory (64)
defaultValues.//dead*-baby-*: any baby: the mod gives babies no rewards beyond a little blood, so one bush meat
defaultValues.//dead*-rotten: any rotten carcass: mostly rot (0.5 each)
defaultValues.//primemeat-*: prime meat: half again a red meat (32)
defaultValues.//healingprimemeat-*: the healing kind: twice prime meat
defaultValues.//*primemeat*: any other prime meat variant: as prime meat
defaultValues.//offal-clean: washed offal: offal plus the work
defaultValues.//sinew*: sinew: like fat (16), a material in the same amounts
defaultValues.//ivory*: ivory: a rare material, like an altar block (64)
defaultValues.//ivoryblock*: a block of ivory: eight pieces
defaultValues.//*bone*: any bone item: like the game's bone (24)
defaultValues.//tinybone*: a tiny bone: a third of a bone
defaultValues.//strongbone*: a strong bone: a bone and a third
defaultValues.//bloodbait*: bait: like the game's fishing bait (4)

litreValues.//bloodportion: blood per litre: between water (1) and milk (10)

relativeValues.//: the game's dough of the same grain, plus a quarter for the blood
the game's bread of the same grain, plus a quarter for the blood
the game's pie, plus a quarter for the blood
